τ_min sweep — the design-closing result

Verdict: with the persistent warp channel (expC), raising τ_min 0.45→0.85 keeps seen-region PSNR (−0.1…−0.5dB) while unseen coherence improves dramatically — content rides the channel, trust rides the noise field. And τ=1.0 (no per-token structure) drops adherence by 1.7–4.4dB: the per-token noise field has independent value beyond the channel. New default: τ_min=0.85.
